_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P2 operational targets.

requirements.description: A single flow spanning two or more devices for cross-device handoff, with per-device leases held for the flow duration.
requirements.title: Multi-device flows

validation.notes: integration phase — planned test `api/flows/multidevice_test.go::TestMultiDeviceFlowHoldsPerDeviceLeases`. A flow spanning two devices holds a lease on each for the flow duration and releases both on terminal state.

requirements.description: Run a flow on a schedule or in response to an event, with the same lease, audit and evidence guarantees as an interactive run.
requirements.title: Scheduled and event-triggered flows

validation.notes: integration phase — planned test `api/flows/schedule_test.go::TestScheduledFlowKeepsLeaseAuditAndEvidenceGuarantees`. A scheduled or event-triggered run carries the same lease, audit and evidence guarantees as an interactive run.

requirements.description: Extend across device classes as new transports become trusted, using the same floor and conformance suite rather than new engines.
requirements.title: Additional device classes

validation.notes: unit phase — planned test `api/strategy/registry_test.go::TestNewDeviceClassNeedsOnlyFloorAndSuite`. Registering a new device class requires only the floor implementation and a passing conformance suite — no executor change.

requirements.description: Export and import flows between owners so the declared capability requirements travel with the flow and are checked against the importing fleet before a run is attempted.
requirements.title: Flow sharing with carried capability requirements

validation.notes: unit phase — planned test `api/flows/portability_test.go::TestImportedFlowIsCheckedAgainstImportingFleet`. An imported flow carries its capability requirements and is checked against the importing fleet before any run is attempted.
